To find the characteristic polynomial of the matrix 
$A = \begin{pmatrix} -4 & -13 & 10 \\ -9 & 10 & 4 \\ 12 & -5 & -14 \end{pmatrix}$, 
we compute $p(\lambda) = \det(\lambda I - A)$:

$$
\lambda I - A = \begin{pmatrix} 
\lambda + 4 & 13 & -10 \\ 
9 & \lambda - 10 & -4 \\ 
-12 & 5 & \lambda + 14 
\end{pmatrix}
$$

Using cofactor expansion along the first row:
$$
\begin{aligned}
p(\lambda) &= (\lambda + 4)\det\begin{pmatrix} \lambda - 10 & -4 \\ 5 & \lambda + 14 \end{pmatrix} 
- 13\det\begin{pmatrix} 9 & -4 \\ -12 & \lambda + 14 \end{pmatrix} 
- 10\det\begin{pmatrix} 9 & \lambda - 10 \\ -12 & 5 \end{pmatrix} \\
&= (\lambda + 4)\big[(\lambda - 10)(\lambda + 14) + 20\big] 
- 13\big[9(\lambda + 14) - 48\big] 
- 10\big[45 + 12(\lambda - 10)\big] \\
&= (\lambda + 4)(\lambda^2 + 4\lambda - 120) 
- 13(9\lambda + 78) 
- 10(12\lambda - 75)
\end{aligned}
$$

Now expand and combine like terms:
$$
\begin{aligned}
(\lambda + 4)(\lambda^2 + 4\lambda - 120) &= \lambda^3 + 4\lambda^2 - 120\lambda + 4\lambda^2 + 16\lambda - 480 \\
&= \lambda^3 + 8\lambda^2 - 104\lambda - 480 \\[4pt]
-13(9\lambda + 78) &= -117\lambda - 1014 \\[4pt]
-10(12\lambda - 75) &= -120\lambda + 750
\end{aligned}
$$

Summing these results:
$$
\begin{aligned}
p(\lambda) &= \lambda^3 + 8\lambda^2 + (-104 - 117 - 120)\lambda + (-480 - 1014 + 750) \\
&= \lambda^3 + 8\lambda^2 - 341\lambda - 744
\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\boxed{\lambda^3 + 8\lambda^2 - 341\lambda - 744}
$$
